full_judgment: 13. P.W.2 Dabir Uddin in his deposition proved the `Zamindari dakhilas' of `Koibara Estate'. This witness who is a man of 74 years of age, testified in his testimony that he knows the plaintiff and the suit land and he was present at the time of settlement of the plaintiff, and the Zamindar `pattan' settled the land followed by an `amolnama'. This witness in his cross-examination specifically testified that, at the age of his 20/22 years in the year 1351 B.S. he was present with the plaintiff, when the plaintiff took the settlement of the land from the Zamindari Estate.
